## Choose the pathway

- **Construction pathway:** use the [premade dimensions and order of operations](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rdGC6nsCR6Z5DtoN071NhLQZxIc3XbFz0cQT_RCSFDs/edit?gid=452419533#gid=452419533), review the parts, and prepare to make the device accurately.
- **Design pathway:** use the [S.O. N.I.C.E. Design Process](../design-process/index.qmd) to understand the situation, identify an opportunity, define the user's needs, and create an original design.

An original design may focus on appearance and finish or add a useful feature such as a smartwatch charger, cable route, jewellery holder, key tray, or another approved function.

## Define the design

For an original design, record:

1. where the holder will be used;
2. which phone or device it must support;
3. what would improve the situation for the user;
4. the necessities and priorities; and
5. whether an added function improves the design or makes it harder to build and use.

Model the individual parts, assemble them digitally, and prepare aligned front, top, right-side, and isometric views. Show overall sizes and the critical dimensions needed to lay out the parts.
